mentions.name: Lexeme
mentions.description: Lexeme is a SaaS service that tracks how AI models like ChatGPT cite and describe a product versus its competitors, and tells users what to fix first based on estimated revenue exposure.
mentions.problem: Businesses lack visibility into how AI models cite and describe their products compared to competitors.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Lexeme (https://trylexeme.com), a SaaS service that tracks how AI models like ChatGPT cite and describe your product vs. competitors, and tells you what to fix first based on estimated revenue exposure.
